no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division determined that the NDA did not raise issues requiring external expert advice. Therefore, an advisory committee meeting was not convened to discuss the application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA 210450 (Orilissa/elagolix). Section 9 of the NDA Multi-Disciplinary Review states the Division determined the application did not raise issues requiring external expert advice, so no AdComm was held. Consequently there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
